**Introsort** (introspective sort). It's a hybrid algorithm that starts with quicksort (giving O(n) best case on already-sorted or nearly-sorted input via partitioning), switches to heapsort when recursion depth exceeds a threshold (guaranteeing O(n log n) worst case), and uses insertion sort for small partitions. It is in-place and is the default sort in C++ STL (`std::sort`).
